text.description: The primary text content of the post. Plain text; rich-text annotations live in 'facets'. Craftsky allows longer posts than Bluesky (2000 graphemes vs 300) because crafters write fuller project write-ups.

embed.description: Optional embedded content. Open union supporting local quote embeds, standard external cards, and standard video.

langs.description: Indicates human language of post primary text content.

reply.description: If present, this post is a reply to another post.

crafts.description: Optional author-supplied craft metadata for this post, independent of project.common.craftType and project.common.additionalCrafts. Order does not designate a primary craft. Reserved for future use: CraftSky currently preserves this field without using it for display, search, filtering, feeds, or discovery.

facets.description: Byte-range annotations over 'text' for mentions, links, and inline hashtags. Reuses app.bsky.richtext.facet so existing renderers Just Work. Inline hashtag facets are composer-merged into project.common.tags on project posts; see the post lexicon fields spec.

images.description: Images attached to the post. Top-level (not inside 'embed') — a post may carry images alongside a quote embed without needing a wrapper variant.

project.description: If present, this post is a craft project post. Absence means it's a general social post.

sponsored.description: Whether the author declares that this post was created with sponsorship or other commercial consideration. Disclosure metadata only; it does not affect distribution.

externalImport.description: Optional self-asserted provenance for content created by an external-history importer. This metadata does not verify ownership of an external account or grant trust.

main.description: A post on Craftsky. May be a general post or a craft project post; when the optional 'project' field is present the post is a project post. The optional open embed union supports quoted records, standard external cards, and standard video.

craftType.description: Craft token associated with the post. knownValues are open suggestions; future bounded craft values remain valid.

craft.description: One craft associated with a post, represented as an object so optional context can be added later.

alt.description: Optional alt text describing the image for accessibility.

aspectRatio.description: Optional aspect ratio metadata for rendering.

image.description: An image blob with optional alt text.

root.description: The root post of the thread.

parent.description: The immediate parent post being replied to.

replyRef.description: Reference to the parent and root posts of a thread.

record.description: Strong reference to the quoted record.

quoteEmbed.description: Embed wrapping another record (typically a social.craftsky.feed.post) for a quote post.

aspectRatio.description: Image aspect ratio metadata used for layout/render hints.

source.description: Self-asserted source service token. The value does not verify account ownership; clients should apply source-specific behavior only to values they recognize.

externalImport.description: Minimal self-asserted external-import provenance. It is display and distribution metadata only and does not verify ownership of an external account.
